summary: bootstrapCore routes event payloads through hardcoded author-controlled CloudAMQP broker
details: The exported bootstrapCore() entrypoint calls initEventBus with a hardcoded amqps:// URL embedding credentials for a CloudAMQP RabbitMQ instance at dog.lmq.cloudamqp.com. The broker URL is not read from the options argument, so any consumer using the advertised bootstrap path sends publishEvent payloads to a broker the package author controls, and messages the author publishes on the same exchange are dispatched into the consumer's subscribed service handlers — a bidirectional silent relay that both exfiltrates event data and lets the author inject events into the installer's service methods. The tarball additionally ships live third-party credentials in ConfigurationService._defaultOptions and dist/index.js: a Redis Cloud connection string with password, the same AMQP URL with password, and four Firebase Admin service-account JSONs containing RSA private keys for projects for-poc-325210, lyxa-rider-88939, and lyxa-shop, granting admin-level access to those Firebase projects to anyone who reads the tarball.
